outcome: Success of trial of labor after cesarean (TOLAC)
cohort: 122 women eligible for a trial of labor after cesarean section (TOLAC)
finding: In carefully selected cases, TOLAC is safe and often successful, with BMI >25 kg/m(2), gestation ≥40 weeks, and vertex station ≥-2 identified as risk factors for unsuccessful TOLAC.
mod_finding: This study investigated factors associated with successful vaginal birth after cesarean delivery and found that higher BMI, later gestational age, and higher fetal head station were associated with unsuccessful trial of labor after cesarean.
